{{Quote|You pay one&mdash;no, two-thousand, yes?''"<br />"''Seven hundred. Or I go find someone else who can help me.''"<br />"''Okay, deal. You have drink to celebrate. On the house.|Quano and Set Harth|<ref name="DoE" />}}
'''Quano''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doan]]. In [[980 BBY]], he took the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Medd Tandar]] to meet with Doan's [[mining caste]]; however, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Miner/Legends|miners]] were all [[Massacre on Doan|assassinated]] by an [[Darth Cognus|Iktotchi assassin]]. Later, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Set Harth]] forced Quano to show him where the [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] on the planet were located. Upon their arrival, Harth [[Death/Legends|killed]] the miners present, and Quano fled. Shortly afterward, when the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] arrived on a [[Mission to Doan|mission]] to investigate Tandar's death, she convinced Quano to help her, and he took her to his friend, [[Pommat]], a [[Janitor/Legends|janitor]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. Pommat told her of his [[Spice/Legends|spice]] smuggling business and revealed that he was aware that she had come from [[Ciutric IV]]. Zannah then killed both Quano and Pommat immediately, as she could not let either of them live with the knowledge of where she and [[Darth Bane/Legends|her Master]] lived.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Last time Quano take someone to meet miners, everyone end up dead. Too risky.''"<br />"''I'm willing to take that chance.''"<br />"''Quano not care about risk for you. Miners say if Quano show up again, they kill him.|Quano and Set Harth|<ref name="DoE" />}}
Quano was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doan]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[New Sith Wars]]. In [[980 BBY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Medd Tandar]] was sent to Doan to investigate the presence of [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] on the world and to mediate the rising tensions between the [[mining caste]] and the [[Doan Royal House]]. He approached Quano regarding the location of the [[Miner/Legends|miners]] who were in charge of the operation and Quano gave him their location. However, during Tandar's meeting with the miners, they were [[Massacre on Doan|attacked and massacred]] by an [[Darth Cognus|Iktotchi assassin]]. After this, the miners told Quano that if they saw him again, they would [[Death/Legends|kill]] him.<ref name="DoE" />

Soon after, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Set Harth]] went to Quano to find information regarding the Sith artifacts that had been dug up earlier. Harth offered Quano [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to reveal the location of the artifacts. Quano believed that Harth was simply a rich [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], so he called his bar's [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] over to mug Harth. However, Harth killed the bodyguards and forced Quano to lead him to [[Draado]], the miner who had dug up the artifacts. Draado had become corrupted by the power of the artifacts, so Harth decided to attack him and the other miners present. During the ensuing fight, Quano fled.<ref name="DoE" />

Later, the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] [[Mission to Doan|arrived]] on Doan to investigate who was responsible for Tandar's death. She eventually came to believe that this person was Harth. After confronting Quano about it, she persuaded him to take her to his friend [[Pommat]], a [[Janitor/Legends|janitor]] and smuggler at the local [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. After Pommat revealed his information regarding the murderer, Zannah gave him and Quano 200 credits each. Pommat also discussed his side business, in which he [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] into visitor's [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and hid shipments of the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]] aboard. He then got in touch with his contact on the starship's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] to sell it. After Zannah asked, he informed her that he did not store any spice on her starship since he had never seen a ship from [[Ciutric IV]] before and had no contacts there. Zannah then killed both Quano and Pommat with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], knowing that she could not allow anyone to hold the knowledge of where she lived. To leave no trace of her visit on Doan, Zannah jettisoned both bodies into Doan's sun.<ref name="DoE" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Go big. Remember, Quano get half.|Quano, to Pommat|<ref name="DoE" />}}
Quano was a poor but confident bartender who served the lowest of the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] caste on Doan. With his bodyguards, he was not afraid to take advantage of those with greater wealth who ventured into his bar, as he did when visited by Set Harth. After the massacre on Doan and his run-in with Harth, he became more wary and afraid of others since his most recent meetings led to his misfortune. Due to his fear and abuse, Darth Zannah found him easy to manipulate, especially when credits were involved&mdash;as witnessed in her meeting with Quano and Pommat.<ref name="DoE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quano was created by author [[Drew Karpyshyn]] for his [[2009]] novel ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''. Quano was both introduced and killed in ''Dynasty of Evil''.
